criteria.name: Modeling depth & fit-for-purpose
criteria.description: Kimball / Inmon / Data Vault chosen from workload + governance constraints (not habit); grain declared; SCDs applied correctly; anti-patterns avoided.

criteria.name: Lakehouse trade-off reasoning
criteria.description: Delta vs Iceberg vs Hudi picked with a defensible reason (ACID / partition evolution / catalog fit / vendor lock-in); ADR is decision-shaped, not survey-shaped.

criteria.name: DW vs Lake vs Lakehouse comparison
criteria.description: Comparison matrix covers cost, latency, governance, ecosystem, ACID, streaming, ML support; failure modes of each named.

criteria.name: Documentation & clarity
criteria.description: Decision memo reads like an architect wrote it — concise, opinionated, cites constraints, ends with a decision line.

criteria.name: Redshift architecture literacy
criteria.description: RA3 vs Serverless picked from workload shape; distribution + sort keys chosen for the fact table given; concurrency scaling, Spectrum, Zero-ETL used where they fit.

criteria.name: AWS-native reference architecture
criteria.description: Ingestion + transformation layer for the bank scenario uses only Glue / EMR / S3 / Lake Formation / Kinesis / MSK / Step Functions — no Databricks / Snowflake — and the choices are defended.

criteria.name: Cost & capacity modeling
criteria.description: Sizing spreadsheet within 15% of realistic AWS pricing across dev/staging/prod; unit economics per workload; FinOps guardrails named.

criteria.name: ADR quality
criteria.description: Provisioned-vs-Serverless and Glue-vs-EMR ADRs surface non-obvious trade-offs (spiky workloads, catalog fit, Spark tuning ceiling), not textbook comparisons.

criteria.name: NFR-first design
criteria.description: Architecture derives from NFRs (security, performance, scalability, reliability, cost, observability, maintainability), not the reverse; Well-Architected Data Analytics Lens scorecard fills honestly.

criteria.name: Enterprise pattern selection
criteria.description: Data mesh vs centralized picked from org shape (BU count, governance maturity); Lambda / Kappa / Delta chosen from freshness SLOs; multi-tenancy pattern matches regulatory constraints.

criteria.name: Data + AI integration
criteria.description: AI/ML treated as first-class citizens of the platform (feature store, training-serving skew, MLOps hooks); RAG vs fine-tune vs prompt-engineering ADR shows real cost/latency reasoning; responsible-AI guardrails present.

criteria.name: Diagram & documentation quality
criteria.description: C4 L1+L2 diagrams are readable, correctly abstracted per level, and match the written NFR matrix.

criteria.name: Migration strategy realism
criteria.description: Six R's applied per workload; 3-wave rollout has real dependencies; risk register names the top 5 risks the panel would raise; rollback strategy is concrete, not aspirational.

criteria.name: Capstone architectural reasoning
criteria.description: Walking-skeleton HLD + LLD hold together under Q&A; decisions log's 3 decisions + 3 risks + 3 week-1 validations are non-generic; the 2-page brief reads like an executive artifact.

criteria.name: Live defense (hostile Q&A + leadership scenario)
criteria.description: Candidate handles pushback without ego; flexes register from CTO exec-pitch to engineer whiteboard; leadership scenario ("best engineer quit mid-migration") answered with concrete moves, not platitudes.

criteria.name: Communication (written + spoken)
criteria.description: CFO exec summary lands in one page; 2-page brief is prose that holds together; defense pitch stays on time and on point.
